newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Swedish NGO to launch air ambulance in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Swedish NGO to launch air ambulance in Bangladesh.

text.p: A Swedish non-government organisation, MAF-Sweden, said on Monday it was planning an air ambulance service in disaster-prone Bangladesh.
The service, using an amphibious light aircraft, would evacuate people needing emergency treatment from remote areas, especially during natural calamities.

"We will start the service as soon as we get permission from the Bangladesh Civil Aviation Authority. It may take some time...(but) the government is providing necessary assistance." Bengt Bryngelson, country director of MAF-Sweden, told Reuters.
Two stretchers can be installed in the aircraft along with provisions for giving oxygen and saline by doctors and attendants accompanying patients, he said.
"We will also provide fast air transportation for relief operations and disaster preparedness in affected areas," he added.
